## Why Tessera?

We pair enterprise-grade infrastructure with genuinely local expertise, so your cloud runs fast, stays sovereign, and never leaves you waiting on a time zone.

:::: {layout-ncol=2 #solutions}

:::: {.feature-card}
**Managed Cloud**  
Fully managed IaaS and PaaS with automated scaling, proactive monitoring, and a dedicated local team that knows your environment by name.
::::

:::: {.feature-card}
**Data Sovereignty**  
Australian-hosted by default. Your data stays under Australian law, in Perth and Sydney regions, with documented cross-border controls for international workloads.
::::

:::: {.feature-card}
**Security and Compliance**  
ISO/IEC 27001 certified, SOC 2 Type II audited, with end-to-end encryption and continuous threat monitoring across all layers.
::::

:::: {.feature-card}
**Local Support**  
Perth-based engineers, not a call centre. 24/7 monitoring with escalation to people who know your stack and your business.
::::
